title: Readout Scaling Shapes Sparse Feature Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.18462v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Readout scaling changes what a sparse autoencoder (SAE) learns, but the benefit of removing it depends on the data. We use readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates to remove singular-value gains while preserving retained decision information. At a fixed readout condition number, changing the generating distribution reverses which training coordinates recover known factors best. In our controlled coordinate-matching study, recovery is highest when training restores the space in which the factors were generated. When factors are generated before readout scaling, RC-DS increases mean sparse-factor recovery from 0.506 to 0.913 at condition number 100, compared with centered-logit training under the same budget. An exact wrapper reproduces RC-DS training to numerical precision, isolating training geometry rather than additional information. In neural policies, RC-DS improves mean logit reconstruction under the tested budgets

translated_title: 读出缩放塑造稀疏特征恢复
translated_abstract: 读出缩放会改变稀疏自编码器（SAE）所学到的内容，但移除它的益处取决于数据。我们使用读出规范化决策空间（RC-DS）坐标来移除奇异值增益，同时保留已保留的决策信息。在固定的读出条件数下，改变生成分布会逆转哪些训练坐标最能恢复已知因子。在我们的受控坐标匹配研究中，当训练恢复了因子生成时所在的空间，恢复效果最好。当因子在读出缩放之前生成时，在条件数为100的情况下，与相同预算下的中心化logit训练相比，RC-DS将平均稀疏因子恢复从0.506提高到0.913。一个精确的包装器以数值精度重现了RC-DS训练，从而分离出训练几何结构而非额外信息的作用。在神经网络策略中，RC-DS在测试预算下改善了平均logit重建。
tldr: 本文提出读出规范化决策空间（RC-DS）坐标方法以消除读出缩放的奇异值增益，并通过受控实验证明当训练恢复因子生成的原始空间时稀疏特征恢复效果最佳，将平均稀疏因子恢复从0.506提升至0.913。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates to remove singular-value gains from readout scaling, and shows through controlled experiments that sparse feature recovery is best when training restores the original factor-generation space, improving mean sparse-factor recovery from 0.506 to 0.913.
